Adani Realty Plans Premium Housing Projects in Mumbai

Adani Realty is planning to launch premium and ultra-luxury residential projects in Mumbai. The company intends to develop these projects in Goregaon and Bandra, expanding its portfolio in the city and utilizing its land bank.
